tasks.design: Configure native collection-to-specification fields in the collections module of {OPS_SYSTEM}, with actual supplier options in {PROCUREMENT} and specifications in {DOCS}. The curator establishes requirements and selects the reproduction route, checks the final record before separate save/delivery, and retains actual manufacture oversight.
tasks.previous_blocker: Object details and chosen reproduction requirements can be repeatedly located and copied.
tasks.enabler_now: Native collection links and specification fields can reduce navigation and repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Fidelity, materials, rights and suitability require direct curatorial judgement and actual sample assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The curator recognises when a replica is technically close but misleading for the object's intended interpretation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated specification entry; curatorial reproduction judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: collections-system links and native specification fields can reuse verified object details; they do not establish fidelity, reproduction rights or manufacturing conformity.

assumptions: Actual collection records have their curator/registrar producer; actual supplier catalogues have the supplier producer. Curator verifies existing measurements and captures any new required measurements/condition/rights findings in retained s1/s3. No unperformed measurement or inferred licence is supplied free.

Manufacture and commercial-replica selection are alternative routes. S8 applies only to actual manufacture; commercial selection retains actual item assessment in s3 and removes/reweights manufacture oversight. Actual written specification/request only where required; no mandatory purchase is inferred from selection.

S4 reduces copying stable object identifiers/measurements and curator-chosen fields only. New requirements capture and full checking remain. S7 applies only within actual curator authority; otherwise it is the actual internal acquisition route, not an unauthorised supplier order. Any later revised specification or formal acceptance record needs its own exact-final-version checked commit/send; no avoided labour claimed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields first; existing prefill earns zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing final checking without added approval work; supplier labour excluded.
unknowns: Which object/specification fields are actually copied today?
research_questions: Can native collection fields reduce entry after full fidelity, rights and final-request checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual collection/specification field mapping and supplier-source links.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final reproduction specification/selection record and exact collection destination; edits require recheck
s5 exact final specification/request, quantities, rights/disclosure scope and authorised supplier/request destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 retrieval + 14*0.30 repeated fields = 10.2; minus 1 upkeep = 9.2. Half eligible gives 5.1 minus 1 = 4.1. Actual requirements, selection, complete final check, save/send and manufacture oversight retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Curators retain reproduction fidelity and supplier judgement while repeated collection-detail administration may shrink.
skills_to_grow: Actual reproduction rights and fidelity assessment
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual repeated fields separately for manufactured reproductions and commercial replicas.
